failures.reason: The official PDF omits TIPO/category for this row; excluded rather than assigning a guessed modality.
The official result was published through an external Drive attachment and was not reliably machine-extractable in this run.
The official validation PDF is image-based/scanned; omitted because text extraction was not reliable without OCR review.

methodology.population: Only rows listed by UNSA as RELACION DE INGRESANTES - ORDEN DE MERITO were aggregated.
methodology.grouping: Each aggregate keeps process, phase, exact category, career/school, specialization and campus separate.
methodology.cutoff: Minimum admitted score in the exact group.
methodology.top: Maximum admitted score in the exact group.
methodology.average: Arithmetic mean of admitted scores in the exact group.
methodology.median: Median of admitted scores in the exact group.
methodology.normalization: Every normalized metric is its native /100 value divided by 5; source scores are never rounded before aggregation.
methodology.privacy: Only aggregates are stored; applicant names and codes are excluded.
methodology.corrections: Psychology 2025-II is replaced with the separate corrected official PDF dated 2025-03-18.
methodology.disclaimer: Historical official reference; it does not guarantee admission or a future minimum score.

warnings: Admission year may differ from the calendar date of the exam.
Exam composition and vacancy counts change by year/process, so scores should be compared within the same route and category.
Eight Extraordinario 2023 aggregates for specialization-based schools are stored as ESPECIALIDAD NO INDICADA because the source groups those rows only at school level.
The 2025 Ordinary I PDF omits TIPO and school codes; NORMAL and codes are explicitly inferred from the ordinary list and cross-year name equivalence.
Campus is marked as inferred Sede Central Arequipa because these are non-filial result lists; filial results are not mixed in.
